args.meaning: Optional front-door argv. Select at most one of --install, --uninstall or --refresh; no selector means refresh. --plan previews the selected act; it is not payload.dry-run. Refresh uses --profile, then HARMONIA_PROFILE_ID, then the hostname before its first dot; only chia-farmer-01, chia-harvester-01 and chia-harvester-02 succeed. Defaults: --unit-dir /etc/systemd/system, --source /fulcrum/attachments/harmonia-monad, --harmonia /usr/local/bin/harmonia, --config /etc/harmonia and --state /var/lib/harmonia.

units.meaning: Resolved unit file paths for install/uninstall.

commands.meaning: Ordered external commands planned or dispatched.

results.meaning: Results in the same order as the executed commands; omitted for a plan, lock skip or pre-dispatch refusal.

argv.meaning: Argument vector passed to the tool.

changed.meaning: Refresh reports true if every command exited zero and false for failed commands or a lock skip; absent otherwise.

skipped.meaning: A concurrent refresh holds the nonblocking lock.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Named operation or parser signal; a ValueError is also returned verbatim, including an unsupported profile suffix.
